_comment: Rules of plan_clean.py, data per R6. Provenance of every rule: written 2026-11-12 after the spec and plans of a night project were found to carry the owner, decision numbers, rule numbers, dates and process notes, which the small local writer model reads as facts about its own world. The detect list is the same pattern the aider-setup manual and local-coder give for a hand check.

substitutions.name: who runs the plan
substitutions.pattern: (?i)run by the local coder model through the driver\.?\s*

substitutions.name: tests are run by the harness, not by the model (step 1)
substitutions.pattern: write the tests, run the file, they fail \((.+?) absent\)
substitutions.replace: write the tests; they must fail while the \1 is absent

substitutions.name: tests are run by the harness, not by the model (step 2)
substitutions.pattern: write the (module|helper), run the file, every test passes
substitutions.replace: write the \1 so that every test passes

substitutions.name: decision numbers on the spec line
repeated section on the spec line
design document sections on the spec line
rule numbers on the spec line
